static_traits.name: Zhang Wei
static_traits.social_status: 与同事关系因对拼写错误的担忧而Tension, estrangement;有几位朋友但not yet向他们分享相关Anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;not yet曾接受心理治疗;近半年因Anxiety导致Sleep disturbance
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰,配合度较好;能具体回顾trigger情境与感受;情绪紧张,Anxiety显著;思维呈灾难化,预测not yet来与过度概括倾向

basic_info.main_problem: 我对自己的拼写能力感到强烈的Anxiety和Fear,认为自己是个糟糕的拼写者,并担心这会导致我被解雇.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询,因为对拼写的Fear与Anxiety已经开始影响我的Work表现和整体身心健康.
growth_experiences: 在求学阶段长期对拼写能力感到not自信,伴随被他人评判的担忧;尽管长期困扰,但never接受过心理咨询或治疗.

core_beliefs: Mistakes will bring serious consequences (e.g. being fired)

special_situations.event: Before needing to send formal emails or conduct written communication at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的文字中出现拼写错误,老板会认为我not专业,最终把我解雇
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复use拼写检查并多次校对,以尽量避免错误
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Any small mistake could cost me my job

special_situations.event: After a colleague pointed out six months ago that there was a spelling error in my email to the boss
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦do not人发现我的错误,他们就会持续关注并negate我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping distance from coworkers,减少交流以避免暴露自己的not足
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会一直盯着我的错误,看not起我

special_situations.event: When receiving negative feedback from colleagues about my spelling
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 被负面评价意味着我not称职,迟早会被解雇
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 进一步回避书面任务或拖延发送,直到反复检查到without法再改

special_situations.event: When needing to write any formal update or small note
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as it is formal writing, I will inevitably make mistakes
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断检查与更改文字,耗费大量时间
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am bound to miss some mistake

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可为称职,被公平对待,not因小错而被评判
core_conflict.fear: Fears being criticized, rejected, and fired, worrying about losing the job and sense of worth
defense_goal: 通过过度校对与Avoids socializing来降低风险,保持安全与掌控感

object_relations.object_representation: A harsh scrutinizer (a boss who might fire him)
Critical critics (colleagues who will stare at mistakes)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a more balanced alternative viewpoint and invites examination of supporting evidence and counter-evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向认为放松警惕会带来严重后果,感觉咨询师低估了风险(移情:将现实中的Anxiety与灾难化期待带入咨询关系)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 坚持强调最坏情况的可能性,语气Anxiety,反复强调'这not现实''我做not到',避免承认积极证据.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the boss's and colleagues' reactions to mistakes while lacking direct evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为他人会持续盯着自己的错误并negate自己(移情:将内在的批判性Projection给他人)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use揣测性语言(如'他们肯定会...'),语气not安,回避具体证据的探讨.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Discusses consequences of possible mistakes and coping near the time of sending an email
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 把小错等同于灾难性后果,并以Over-preparation来缓解Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 强调需要not断检查与准备,列出详细步骤以降低风险,语气谨慎而紧绷.

manifestations: Relationships with colleagues grow distant from worry about mistakes
not yet向朋友分享与拼写相关的Anxiety与Fear

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequent self-reproach (such as 'I am a terrible speller')
Before sending any email, repeatedly checks and proofreads
Keeps distance from colleagues for fear of judgment

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 将'not能犯错/必须完美写作'当作绝对标准
Internalizes one instance of a colleague pointing out a mistake into persistent self-regulation and vigilance

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: 认为上司会看not起或解雇自己(缺乏直接证据)
揣测同事会持续盯着自己的错误并negate自己

exception_events.target_problem: 在需要进行书面沟通(如发送Work邮件)时,来访者通常会灾难化并预测最坏结果,从而产生强烈Anxiety并反复校对,回避与拖延.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 某次在Work邮件里出现了一个小的拼写错误,同事只是更正并继续处理Work,not yet被上司批评或追究,事件很快过去.
exception_events.reason: not同支持/情境:同事以更正与继续Work为导向,have not放大错误;现实反馈显示小错并not yet带来严重后果.

positive_force: 能够use拼写检查与多次校对等策略
Willing to proactively seek counseling help
Still retains passion for dance work
拥有几位可以交谈的朋友(虽not yet分享该Anxiety)
negative_force: 灾难化,预测not yet来与过度概括的认知模式
过度自我苛责与Self-monitoring,担心他人评价
Damaged self-identity ('I am a terrible speller')

target_behavior.behavior: 在Work书面沟通前出现的强烈Anxiety与强迫性反复校对
antecedent: Needing to send emails or formal written materials
Realizing colleagues once pointed out spelling mistakes
收到或Anticipation收到对拼写的负面反馈
target_behavior.core_reason: 长期的拼写not自信与被评判Fear;将小错灾难化并预测被解雇
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential negative evaluation or punishment, gaining short-term safety and a sense of control
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased work efficiency与表现受损;Anxiety维持;Sleep disturbance与Decreased attention

antecedent: Worrying that colleagues or supervisors will notice one's spelling errors
Needing to discuss written content or emails with colleagues
target_behavior.core_reason: 害怕被他人评判,过度概括一次错误为持续的negate
target_behavior.function: Escapes criticism and shame; maintains surface safety
target_behavior.consequence: Tense relationships with colleagues,Decreased support,孤立加剧,进一步恶化Anxiety与Work表现
